info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Disputes-v4-spec
info.description: The Payments Dispute Management API enables users to retrieve detailed information about payment disputes associated with their transactions. This endpoint allows businesses to effectively monitor and manage disputes, providing insights into the status and resolution of each case. Typical consumers of this API include finance teams, dispute resolution specialists, and customer support agents, who require access to dispute data for effective resolution and reporting. With this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency in handling disputes, ensuring a smoother customer experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve details about a specific payment dispute, including its status and any associated information required for resolution.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about a payment dispute. Please ensure that the required parameters are included in the request to filter the disputes accordingly.
